column1: At low magnification, colorectal adenocarcinoma NOS may show irregular gland-forming tumor architecture and infiltrative glands within fibrous tissue.
At low magnification, colorectal mucinous adenocarcinoma may show broad extracellular mucin pools containing tumor and mucinous tumor extending between tissue compartments.
At high magnification, colorectal adenocarcinoma NOS may show atypical epithelium surrounding irregular lumina and elongated hyperchromatic tumor nuclei.
At high magnification, colorectal mucinous adenocarcinoma may show malignant epithelial clusters suspended in mucin and hyperchromatic nuclei in floating tumor clusters.
